name: Kumenan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kumenan town emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kumenan, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1964.

features.role: Kumenan town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a disc
